name: Futari no Ouji
source:
Uzuki Miru, 2nd year student at the AbelCain Academy has come to a different world, "Haraiso" via unexpected circumstances. There, days and days of perverted experiences and unscrupulous behavior with a pair of very individual princes is in store for him!

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034028.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
阿贝尔凯恩学院二年级学生卯月美露因意外的情况来到了异世界“原矶”。在那里，日复一日的变态经历和不择手段的行为正在等待着他！

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034028.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
